scientific_integrity: Analytic proofs of necessity, sufficiency, and uniqueness are included; finite symbolic/numerical replay is supporting evidence, not an infinite-domain certificate. Prior qualitative short-long mixing is credited and independent scientific validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Exactly alternating positive intervals, scalar integrator, noiseless one-sample-index delay and fixed gain only; the optimizer minimizes asymptotic Floquet spectral radius, not finite-time transient or random-schedule gain. The fully comparable 2022 mixed-interval control paper was accessible only at the abstract level.
title: Exact mean-period stabilization and optimal alternating delayed-sample control
